name: SABLE OPEN CHANNEL
description: Vantablack's mass-market holographic broadcast arm, designed to serve Tier 2 audiences priced out of neural-feed subscriptions. Content is algorithmically optimized for engagement metrics, cycling reality formats, sports highlights, and sponsored lifestyle programming across public projection nodes and residential display units. The network is free at point of access, funded entirely by embedded advertising and corponation sponsorship.
cultural_impact: Normalized corponation sponsorship as an invisible infrastructure of daily entertainment, making the distinction between advertising and content functionally meaningless for millions of Tier 2 viewers.
story_hooks: A Tier 2 housing block's public projection node begins showing Sable Open Channel content that doesn't match the scheduled broadcast — someone is feeding alternate programming into the node's signal.
An investigative journalist traces the behavioral data pipeline from Sable Open Channel viewership logs directly to Axiom's workforce reallocation algorithm.

A holographic technician maintaining public projection nodes across the Shelf boundary discovers that certain nodes receive an additional encrypted signal packet with every Sable Open Channel broadcast.
